description: No Needs Document paired. Every step that reads one is inapplicable, not failing.
specRow: S2.1 / S9.4: with no paired document, needRefs resolution and all of coverage emit nothing.
note: expectSchemaValid is null because there is no document to validate. The bundle deliberately carries both an uncited unit and an unresolvable citation: paired, those would be NEED-COVERAGE-002 and NEED-REF-001. Unpaired they are silence, and a processor MUST NOT infer a pairing from co-location or file naming.
